name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes where other upscalers blur edges or lose depth cues, directly boosting output quality. The trade-off is slightly higher compute cost per frame, but the 0.5%+ quality gain justifies it—especially since EXCAVA already handles depth maps. Skip the face lock for now; depth upscaling fixes a broader failure mode before we optimize for a niche case.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem isn’t resolution—it’s motion blur from fast motion or low shutter speed. RealVisXL 5.0’s face lock won’t help either; it locks *style*, not motion clarity. Test a motion-deblur model like Flowframes’ VFI module first—if it recovers 0.5%+ facial detail in high-motion clips, that’s the real upgrade.
